problem_text:
A logistics network must allocate computational tasks across a distributed processing framework to minimize total data transmission latency between source clusters and destination servers.

The available processing capacity at each source cluster (set C) is defined as:  
*C1 can handle 87 task units.  
*C2 can handle 80 task units.  
*C3 can handle 164 task units.  
*C4 can handle 94 task units.  
*C5 can handle 92 task units.  
*C6 can handle 104 task units.  
*C7 can handle 99 task units.  
*C8 can handle 82 task units.  
*C9 can handle 60 task units.  
*C10 can handle 158 task units.

The required computational load that must be satisfied at each destination server (set D) is:  
*D1 requires 89 units.  
*D2 requires 27 units.  
*D3 requires 107 units.  
*D4 requires 20 units.  
*D5 requires 76 units.  
*D6 requires 41 units.  
*D7 requires 93 units.  
*D8 requires 104 units.  
*D9 requires 11 units.  
*D10 requires 71 units.

The latency per unit of data transferred from each source cluster to each destination server is provided in the table below:

| From / To | D1 | D2 | D3 | D4 | D5 | D6 | D7 | D8 | D9 | D10 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| C1 | 18 | 11 | 9 | 17 | 15 | 1 | 20 | 19 | 17 | 14 |
| C2 | 4 | 14 | 5 | 5 | 19 | 19 | 19 | 4 | 4 | 19 |
| C3 | 4 | 10 | 18 | 12 | 14 | 9 | 13 | 16 | 19 | 20 |
| C4 | 16 | 2 | 6 | 9 | 13 | 5 | 20 | 20 | 13 | 2 |
| C5 | 13 | 11 | 8 | 2 | 16 | 9 | 12 | 1 | 11 | 10 |
| C6 | 10 | 9 | 16 | 4 | 8 | 5 | 10 | 15 | 11 | 9 |
| C7 | 14 | 20 | 3 | 7 | 15 | 7 | 14 | 16 | 17 | 12 |
| C8 | 2 | 17 | 6 | 3 | 10 | 17 | 13 | 5 | 17 | 19 |
| C9 | 1 | 6 | 7 | 7 | 2 | 8 | 2 | 15 | 2 | 12 |
| C10 | 7 | 9 | 12 | 15 | 17 | 13 | 4 | 1 | 8 | 12 |

Determine the optimal allocation of task units to minimize the aggregate transmission latency.
